title: A dilation of an integer multiplicity current is integer multiplicity
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, a ∈ ℝ^P, λ > 0 and η := dilation a λ. Let X, X' ∈ 𝒟_m(ℝ^P) with X'(ω) = λ^{−m}X(ω') for all ω, ω' ∈ 𝒟^m(ℝ^P) with ω'(y) = ω(η(y)) for every y. If X is integer multiplicity (X = τ(M, θ, ξ) for some IMRep (M, θ, ξ) in ℝ^P; contract IsIntegerMultiplicity), then X' is integer multiplicity.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (a : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → ∀ X X' : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, (∀ ω ω' : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, (∀ y : Euclid P, (ω' : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) y = (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) (dilation a lam y)) → X' ω = lam⁻¹ ^ m * X ω') → IsIntegerMultiplicity X → IsIntegerMultiplicity X'
